proof_checks: Both results directly consume existing actual-iterate gradient_descent_weighted_value_bound. No duplicate descent or recurrence proof and no scalar bound supplied as an extra assumption.
Convex branch sets alpha0 through strongConvexOn_zero, correctly simplifies q=1 and N terms. h>0 and N>0 justify division by2*h*N. Gap may have either sign; no minimizer needed.

Strong branch derives0<=q<1 from alpha>0,h>0,alpha*h<=1. Positive N gives q^N<1, including q0. Multiply weighted bound by positive alpha, use geometric-sum identity with1-q=alpha*h, and divide by2*(1-q^N)>0. Signs and factor2 match source.

Inverse branch is under additional alpha*h<1, hence q>0 and q^N>0. Integer negative powers are rewritten using zpow_neg and zpow_natCast; field algebra proves exactly alpha*q^N*distance²/[2*(1-q^N)] = alpha/[2*(q^(-N)-1)]*distance². q^N<1 and q^N>0 exclude both denominator singularities.
At alpha*h=1, rational conclusion holds with zero numerator and positive denominator2, while inverse conclusion is conditional on an impossible strict hypothesis; no totalized inverse at q0 is used.

Global C1 and upper model use actual Riesz gradient and actual N-fold update map. Arbitrary comparator can yield negative gap; no hidden lower bound or attainment is needed. Beta may be signed under explicit upper-model assumptions; source reciprocal step correspondence needs beta>0.
Normalized h0,N0 and strong alpha0 are excluded; convex alpha0 branch is proved directly, not by an analytic alpha-limit claim.

The added exact inverse-power representation is explicitly identified as new; no novel descent/recurrence mathematics claimed.
